title: Mathematics claim
description: Extends frame-claim-v1 with what must not drift in this field. The GIVEN and CLAIM blocks are hashed SEPARATELY because the characteristic failure here is a CLAIM quietly weakening while the GIVEN stays put — separate hashes say which happened.

formal_target.description: The statement as it must appear in the artifact, with quantifier order explicit.

allowed_external_facts.description: Results the argument may cite. A citation outside this list is out-of-scope — not a step, and not a shortcut.

preconditions.description: Hypotheses that must be discharged locally before the citation is legitimate.

resolved_in_corpus.description: False means this is a search target, not an available premise. A guessed declaration name is not evidence.

axiom_allowlist.description: Axioms the checked result may depend on. Anything beyond this is an escape hatch a plain type-check will not surface.

bounded_search.description: Frozen before the search runs, so a failing search cannot be rescued by shrinking the range.

toolchain.description: Pinned checker and library revision. A receipt from a different toolchain is about a different system.
